text_block_list.text:
The day of the Yasuda Kinen arrived. Up 
until this day, I took the utmost care 
regarding Sakura Chiyono O's physical 
condition.
choice_data_list: What else can I do right before...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing left behind. Horseshoes have been 
checked, too."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ……Maybe I should check one more time?
choice_data_list:
If you're worried, want to check it 
together?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wah!? U-Um...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Then, if you please...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ I'm sorry. Thank you for taking care 
of me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“Outfit's good, horseshoes are good! And 
last night's sleep was super great 
too—alriiiight!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I have zero worries now! Today, on the GⅠ 
stage, I'll be sure to bring home top-tier 
results for you.
choice_data_list: You're looking fired up, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...! Absolutely!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's the perfect stage to showcase the 
results of all the training and power I've 
gained.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure I'm still in my growth spurt, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—My peak doesn't matter! I'll show you I'm 
still in my prime growth phase!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here it is, the Yasuda Kinen! 
Umamusume boasting tremendous speed take 
on the 1,600-meter mile battle!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Do your best~! Bamboo-chaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, isn't that Super Creek? Why is she 
cheering for Bamboo Memory?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you didn't know? Those two are 
actually pretty close.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, it was Super Creek who 
advised Bamboo to try running on turf as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"'You're remarkably strong on turf, too,' 
they said. And Bamboo delivered results, 
leading to where she is today!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I see~. If someone as strong as Creek 
is cheering for her, then Bamboo Memory 
must be super strong too!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Yes.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-chan is very strong, you know...♪
